effect.description: Use for Effect 4 APIs, Schema, services, Layers, resource lifetimes, Node platform adapters and tests. Read its agent guidance and compare branch source with the installed package declarations before using an API.

herdr.description: Use for Herdr socket dispatch, protocol schemas, client-shell binary codecs, events and terminal resource behaviour. Check the SDK's recorded upstream commit and bundled schema when the branch has newer protocol changes.

herdr-sdk-upstream.description: Use for upstream SDK changes, public API conventions, lifecycle tests and compatibility when maintaining this fork or preparing an upstream contribution.
